dedupe_keys.name: deliverable d2 3 supplementary material input files for the transport and fate modelling in the urban surface waters of berlin

description: Markus, Arjen and colleagues publish this resource through Zenodo. The published DELWAQ inputs describe two settings: an illustrative Flughafensee lake and the wider Berlin surface-water system. Lake parameters are expressly rough representations based on the Berlin water atlas. The larger network and flow field draw on KWB information and the BIBER model. A bundled auxiliary program generates a consistent schematisation from branches, connections, widths, lengths and flows. That utility is part of the input package, without an independently established general software product. The data support urban contaminant-transport simulations; accurate operational reproduction of every waterway is not asserted. Coverage is limited to the stated models, observations and application settings. Native metadata gives open access and the licence label cc-by-4.0. These terms describe the deposit; software and companion-data terms are distinguished where separately established. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected; linked data, code and document bodies were not opened.
